artworks.title: Mois, mon avis est ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men from the knees up, positioned to face each other. Both men have distinct facial features. The man on the left is wearing a tall top hat, appears older with sideburns and a large nose, and looks slightly surprised. He is wearing a long coat over a crumpled shirt with striped pants, and his hands rest on his hips. The man on the right is dressed in a brimmed hat, checkered pants, and a large coat, with his face angled towards the side. His expression appears more neutral. He is holding a cigarette in his right hand and gesturing towards the other man with his left hand. In the background, there are faint outlines of trees and an open landscape sketched, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Mais ou est donc le perdreau
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a hunter and another person in a domestic setting. The hunter has a rifle and a game bag, while the other person appears to be holding a jar or pot. The setting suggests a home interior with a bottle on the floor and framed artwork on the walls. The figures seem to be interacting, with the hunter gesturing towards the contents of the game bag. The drawing uses shading and line work to convey texture and depth, portraying a humorous or domestic moment.

artworks.title: Archimède riant des efforts ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure labeled "Archimède" using a telescope to observe a large blimp-like object in the distance in a busy area with smaller objects. The figure is seated on clouds with a flowing robe and a bearded head. The style resembles 19th-century caricature drawings with textures in the background.

artworks.title: L'ingénieur du Leviathan trouvant, en rève ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts an abstract composition with bold, sweeping lines and rounded shapes converging. Three large balloons are connected by lines to a substantial ship-like structure on cloud-like forms. Above the ship are curved shapes resembling wings. The lower part of the image has swirling lines similar to clouds or waves, creating a dream-like, imaginative scene.

artworks.title: J'veux monter tout de suite la-dedans ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from behind. One is an adult male on the left holding an umbrella in his right hand, wearing a long coat and a top hat. The other is a child on the right, slightly in front of the adult, pointing upward with their left hand. The background features a large, airborne structure resembling a massive dirigible or balloon with two spherical sections. Faint outlines of buildings or a town are visible below. The scene is sketched with visible lines and shading, providing a textured and old-fashioned appearance.

artworks.title: Paris grippé
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows several people wearing heavy clothing in Paris. The figures are bundled up in coats, shawls, and hats. They appear uncomfortable, possibly due to cold weather. The drawing depicts a crowded street scene with the title "Paris grippé."

artworks.title: Allons, v'la encore le mouton qui a haussé
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a butcher's shop. Two individuals are depicted among hanging carcasses. The central figure raises a flag while pointing upwards. The person on the left holds a pole with a piece of meat tied to the top and seems to interact with the second figure on the right. The background shows hanging meat or carcasses. The drawing portrays a moment of interaction through expression and gesture. It is rendered in a sketch-like style with visible pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Le désespoir des bouchers
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a butcher shop. The butcher stands at center left with a raised cleaver in one hand, looking towards the ceiling. Various cuts of meat hang from hooks in the background. Another figure leans forward across a table with face resting on forearms. The drawing's lines convey emotion and movement.

artworks.title: Comment ... c'est-t'y dieu possible! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a butcher's shop display with meat hanging and characters observing. In the foreground, there are two figures dressed in long, dark coats and bonnets standing in front of a display counter laden with various cuts of meat. Behind them, hanging from hooks, are larger sections of meat, such as beef or lamb carcasses. The artist has used contrasts between light and shadow to create depth and expression. The dialogue at the bottom suggests an interaction related to the meat.

artworks.title: Cocher, Cocher! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two jesters interacting with a coachman seated on a carriage. The drawing shows two figures dressed in traditional jester or clown-like costumes talking to a tall, hatted individual perched atop a horse-drawn carriage. The coachman appears to be responding to the gestures of the jesters. The medium is a black and white sketch characterized by loose, fluid lines conveying movement. The expressions and body language add urgency and narrative depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Commencant a trouver que l'impèriale ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals seated closely together on the roof of an omnibus during a heavy rainstorm. They are all visible from head to toe, facing the viewer with a side profile. The person on the left is hunched forward, holding an umbrella. The central figure sits upright, wearing a tall top hat that covers most of their facial features. The person on the right, also in a top hat, appears to have sharp facial features and is slightly hunched forward, possibly knitting, with their head bent downward. All three individuals are wearing long coats. Rain is depicted in thick diagonal lines, emphasizing the downpour. The background is filled with more lines, suggesting the intensity of the rain, with no distinguishable landmarks visible.

artworks.title: Apparition du ... serpent de la rue Lacépède
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bustling street scene with a group of people dressed in 19th-century attire gathered on the street. They are all looking upward with expressions of surprise or interest. In the background, there are buildings with multiple windows. At the top of the image, there is a creature or figure that resembles a serpent with a bird-like head positioned above them. The drawing captures a moment of curiosity and conversation, highlighting the interaction between the observers and the unusual sight they are witnessing. The scene is rendered in black and white, with expressive lines and shading that convey motion and atmosphere.

artworks.title: La répétition
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene. The scene is depicted in a sketch style, illustrating three figures engaged in conversation. One figure stands with expressive posture and gestures towards the others; another is kneeling, and the third figure stands back holding a book. The background shows a simple interior setting. The artwork is monochromatic, using shades of black.

artworks.title: Voyez, cette pièce est très grande ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing face-to-face in conversation. The man on the left is wearing a long dark coat, while the man on the right is wearing a double-breasted coat with tails, a cravat, and holding a black top hat. They are surrounded by a drawn curtain, revealing an alcove or a stage-like area with a simple background. In the lower left corner, there is an abstractly sketched chair or piece of furniture.

artworks.title: Rappelès avec enthousiasme! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals, a man and a woman, leaning forward from behind a curtain or stage wing. The man, on the right, is bent slightly forward and looking down, while the woman, to his left, is seated, leaning forward with her arm resting on her knee. Both have their attention directed towards the crowd. The man has a prominent nose and receding hairline, with short hair. The woman appears to have her hair pulled back and tied. They are dressed in period clothing, with the woman wearing a long dress and the man in a suit. In front of them are candles on a stand and a spherical lamp. The background shows a crowded audience, depicted with expressions of laughter and engagement, seated closely together.

artworks.title: Eh bien! Mon brave anglais ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a humorous caricature style. The drawing features two men standing face-to-face in conversation. On the left, a tall, thin figure is dressed in a checked pattern. Their posture is upright and slightly stiff, with hands in pockets. On the right, a short, squat figure is humorously dressed as a Roman soldier, complete with a crested helmet and a rounded belly. The soldier leans forward in a dynamic posture. The drawing is sketched with clear, exaggerated lines. The background is minimal. The artist uses shading to add dimension and texture to the figures' clothing and features.

artworks.title: Voyons ... ouvrons le bouche! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, one standing and one seated. The standing person is holding a dental tool, looking intently at the seated individual. The standing person has messy hair and a focused expression. The seated person appears tense, with closed mouth and a frowning expression. The background includes a patterned curtain.

artworks.title: Un soir de première représentation
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back turned to the viewer, facing an audience. The person's hands are raised in a gesture. They have short, dark hair and wear a dark, flowing garment. To the left is another figure in a box or balcony. The background shows an auditorium filled with people and rows of seating. The artwork is framed within a publication layout with text at the top and bottom.

artworks.title: Ne soyez pas inquiets ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three people standing from the waist up. Two are facing the third person on the left. The person on the left is wearing a cap and glasses and appears to be gesturing with raised hands. They have short, slightly wispy hair. The person in the middle has a round face with a broad smile and lightly drawn hair. The person on the right is wearing a tall hat, has a noticeable smile, facial lines suggesting age or expression, and is holding a cane. The background is plain with a diagonal shadow, and there are inscriptions on the top and bottom indicating the artwork's description and date.

artworks.title: Vue d'un atelier ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist in a studio. The drawing shows a figure holding a palette and brush, pointing towards a canvas with faint figures. Another figure sits on the ground in a contemplative pose, also facing the canvas with a palette and brushes. The studio is cluttered with artistic tools, including a table with bottles.

artworks.title: Moi ce que j'aime dans la salle de sculpture ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated next to each other on a bench, depicted from head to knee. Both are positioned in a relaxed manner. The man on the left is slouched with his head drooping forward, while the man on the right is leaning back with his mouth open. The left man has a mustache, a top hat covering his hair, and a somber expression. The right man also wears a top hat and has facial hair with slightly curly hair. Both are dressed in dark suits, with the man on the right holding his hat. Others around them are engaging in various activities and wearing formal attire. To the left is a pedestal and a partially shown sculpture, and to the right are three more sculptures. The background shows faintly sketched figures and shadows, suggesting a museum or exhibition setting.

artworks.title: M. Prud'homme: Je ne monte jamais ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals at a train station having a conversation. The scene shows two figures engaged in a dialogue, one pointing inside a train compartment while the other looks on with a surprised expression. Both appear to be somewhat formally dressed with hats. The line work is detailed and expressive, capturing the figures' emotions and the atmosphere of the scene. The drawing includes dialogue in French at the bottom, giving context to the interaction. There is an interior view of a train compartment in the background. The location and the style of the clothing hint at a setting from the past.

artworks.title: Ils on l'air de se concerter ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three men are depicted sitting inside a train compartment. The two men on the left are engaged in conversation. The man on the left has short hair and a contemplative expression, wearing a dark jacket and a shirt with an open collar. The man next to him is slightly turned towards him. He has sideburns, is wearing a tall top hat, and is dressed in a formal suit with a vest. The third man, on the right, is seated slightly apart from the other two, holding a cane. He has a lined face, wears a lighter hat, and his clothing is more casual with a lighter coat and shirt underneath. The background is detailed with textured curtains, suggesting the interior of a vintage-style train.

artworks.title: Grand train de plaisir
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a crowd of people in a state of excitement or surprise, facing the same direction. The figures have exaggerated facial expressions typical of caricature art. The drawing uses cross-hatching and line work for texture and shading, giving a sense of urgency and depth. One figure in the foreground is carrying luggage. Indistinct architectural elements are visible in the background. The illustration conveys movement and animated reactions among the figures.
